title: Maintenance knowledge pilot
objective: Prepare a sourced response draft for service engineers; never send it automatically.
data: Redacted manuals; owner-approved versions; engineer-role access controls.
output: Draft, document version and source location; abstain without evidence.
acceptance: Include ordinary, unanswerable, version-conflict and unauthorized samples; review facts and citations; disclose no unauthorized content.
recovery: Version sources and prompts; route failures to review; restore the last verified version.
excluded: No production tickets, access changes or automatic customer commitments.
